note: Both sets are fully accurate against the page: every value, unit, binding and quote checks out, and both keep the needed region/condition qualifiers (e.g. Region 3 constant-power condition for the inverse relation, Region 1 before cut-in for zero torque). Set A uniquely captures the rated generator torque (43,093.55 N·m), the 97:1 gearbox ratio and the Region 2 optimal constant (0.0255764 N·m/rpm²); Set B uniquely captures the peak power coefficient (0.482 at TSR 7.55, 0.0° pitch, 8 m/s), rated mechanical power (5.296610 MW), the 2½-to-3 transitional speed (1,161.963 rpm) and the Region 2 square-law relation. These are equally valid, well-supported facts, so the sets are about equally good; the only mild weakness is B's region-count claim, which is of low engineering value.
remarks: Both extractions are clean: quotes are verbatim and support their claims, and conditions (Region 1/2/3, 30% above 670 rpm, 99% of rated speed) are retained. B's 'number of control regions = 5' is correct but borderline trivial. Facts on the page that neither shown sample covers (e.g. generator-slip 10% in Region 2½, minimum rotor speed 6.9 rpm, rated generator speed 1173.7 rpm, 94.4% efficiency) are presumably in the unshown identical claims.
